         **Review examples:**
            1. _Raj Sharma_, Jul 21, 2026, 1/5: "I wouldn't recommend using this app. My money ended up getting stuck for no clear reason, and despite providing every document the support team requested, I couldn't get the issue resolved. Reaching customer support was frustrating, and they never provided a satisfactory solution. Based on my experience, I'd suggest being cautious before using it."
            2. _ubaidullah md._, Jul 20, 2026, 1/5: "I deposited funds on slice savings account with the idea to save more but due to regular transactions they disabled my incoming transactions and adding funds to savings was frozen. Even after sending out my bank statements via email as proof they refused to unfreeze my savings account. Very disappointed with the customer retention policy and i conclude this app to be unreliable for long term use."

## **Sync and account issues** {#theme-sync_accounts}

   **Sync and account issues.**
      1 recent review(s) mention sync and account issues.
      Review window: Jul 21, 2026 - Jul 21, 2026
      **Why it matters:** Users report broken sync, backup, login, or account problems. This points to trust and reliability gaps.

         **Review examples:**
            1. _Neyazur Rahman_, Jul 21, 2026, 1/5: "I was a loyal slice user for years, borrowed multiple loans, and always repaid on time with interest. After my last loan in October 2025, my borrowing limit suddenly became ₹0. Support promised it would be restored after clearing all dues, but even after full payment, nothing changed. They only sent automated replies and kept closing tickets without any real resolution. Frustrated, I permanently deleted my account. Very disappointing customer support and zero transparency."
